title: Transplants performed vs new people added to the waitlist (count, per year)
notes: 'New people added to the waitlist' is calculated from HRSA/organdonor.gov's widely cited rate of one new person added to the national transplant waiting list every 7 minutes (525,600 minutes/year / 7 ~= 75,086/year, rounded here to 75,086). 'Transplants performed' is UNOS's actual 2025 total (49,064). The gap is why the list can't shrink even in a record year.

points.label: New people added to waitlist (per year)
